⚠️_recall_ceiling: These goldens were seeded from the 2026-08-29 run and verified against the PDF. Recall is therefore measured AGAINST A VERIFIED REFERENCE SET, not against the document: an element no run emits is missing from the golden too and cannot be detected here. Report it as such.

findings.4_parser_coverage_is_a_range_not_a_point: 0.807 / 0.927 / 0.841, stdev 0.062, tracking dropped counts of 40/15/33 — all age_band. Field accuracy by contrast is 0.995 stdev 0.002.
